description: Expected results for the official APEX0806 Riesel TX example (ex1_RiselTX from the 'APEX v.0806 Editor' download, Texas A&M AgriLife, 2015-09-23): one 10-year run (1998-2007), 4 subareas (3 crop fields + rangeland), daily weather from A48309.dly. inputs/ are the unmodified official files. The fort.* checks compare against the official side outputs the APEX team's own run wrote (shipped in the same download, kept in reference/). The other checks were recorded from our run; two clean runs gave identical outputs apart from the date/time stamp lines.
engine_version: APEX0806 (APEX0806.exe, PE32 build of 2015-05-01, sha256 eb387764a78bf250dbf59fd2ce80c6603aa714b780c6ae65465598607d603573) under wine-9.0

numeric_checks.name: fort102_maxdiff_vs_official
numeric_checks.why: end-of-run totals and manure/fertilizer balance (fort.102) equal the official file, every printed number

numeric_checks.name: fort108_maxdiff_vs_official
numeric_checks.why: yearly watershed water/nutrient balance table (fort.108, 10 years x 56 columns) equals the official file

numeric_checks.name: fort108_years
numeric_checks.why: one row per simulated year 1998-2007 (official fort.108 has 10)

numeric_checks.name: water_balance_error_pct
numeric_checks.why: APEX TOTAL WATER BALANCE PER in OUTPUT.OUT; closes to about 3e-4 %

numeric_checks.name: acy_rows
numeric_checks.why: crop-year rows in OUTPUT.ACY (4 subareas, 10 years, rotations)

numeric_checks.name: corn_mean_yield_t_ha
numeric_checks.why: mean CORN grain yield YLDG (t/ha) over the 14 harvests

numeric_checks.name: aws_runoff_qts_sum_mm
numeric_checks.why: sum of yearly outlet flow QTS (mm) in OUTPUT.AWS, 1998-2007

finished_check: s6_run_apex returns rc=0 with no accepted terminal fault, EPICERR.DAT has no ERROR, and OUTPUT.OUT holds TOTAL WATER BALANCE, TOTAL SEDIMENT BALANCE and TOTAL RUN TIME
recorded_with: /mnt/disk1/Hydrocraft_server/models/APEX/knowledge_infrastructure/reference/APEX0806.exe (same bytes as the exe in the official download) run through the KI tools/s6_run_apex.py; crop table read with tools/s7_parse_output.py
reference: reference/fort.102, fort.108, fort.112, fort.128 = official side outputs from the APEX v.0806 Editor download (ApexEditor(09232015)/ex1_RiselTX, dated 2015-09-04). The download ships no OUTPUT.* files, so the crop/AWS/water-balance values come from our own run.
notes: Our run reproduces all four official fort.* files byte for byte. The tolerance on fort.* is 0 on the printed numbers.
